description: Council energy consumption is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Data Mill North. Energy consumption of council sites from council buildings to street lighting. The data set includes the energy consumption, associated costs and from 2013/14 carbon emissions. The council has a corporate energy policy, published on the Leeds City Council website, which outlines the direction the council is moving to reduce energy from its operations. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Data Mill North. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
